speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, how many weeks old are you, and when did you first notice the yellowing?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Lactational Jaundice).

The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with increasing jaundice and stable weight gain is classic for this condition. I will not order further tests as the history is sufficient for management, which involves increasing breastfeeding frequency.
